newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SIOEN INDUSTRIES POSTS STRONG PROFITS GROWTH.
newsitem.headline: SIOEN INDUSTRIES POSTS STRONG PROFITS GROWTH.

text.p: Belgium's Sioen Groep, the technical textiles group which is seeking a bourse listing in Brussels, said in Monday it posted strong growth in turnover and earnings in the first half of 1996.
Group net profits amounted to 130 million Belgian francs in the period to 30 June 1996. It gave no comparative figure for the first half of 1995, but said full year profit was 173 million.
Cashflow was 213 million in the first half compared with 297 million in the whole of 1995.
Turnover was 1.70 billion in the first six months. It had been 2.90 billion in the whole of last year.
The company plans to list 30 percent of its capital in a listing organised by Generale Bank in cooperation with Lessius. KB-Securities will be part of the syndicate.
Subscriptions open on September 30 and close on October 8.
Sioen coats synthetic fabrics, makes protective clothing and produces pigment pastes. The group said it was well-placed for further growth in each of its markets.
